text:
Maya Chen: quick a11y pass on the Console dashboards — did a screen reader + keyboard run, filing a few nits below.
Samir Patel: awesome, thanks. high-level notes? :eyes:
Maya Chen: 1) Contrast — some secondary labels (muted gray) drop below 4.5:1 on the dark header. sees ~3.2:1. prefer bump to #BFC9D6 or use bold for small caps.
Jin Park: which element? can you paste selector or screenshot?
Maya Chen: the small metadata under widgets — `.dashboard-metadata small` in the header. 2) Focus states — tab ring uses the same blue as background in dark mode, nearly invisible. suggest 2px solid #FFD166 or `outline-offset: 2px` for visibility.
Alex Ruiz: agree on focus. also noticed focus order skips the chart legend when using keyboard — tab goes from chart canvas straight to export button.
Samir Patel: that's bad — probably because legend is `tabindex="-1"` for pointer-only interactions. we should make it keyboard-accessible.
Maya Chen: 3) ARIA — the modal summary is `role="dialog"` but missing `aria-labelledby` and `aria-modal="true"`. screen reader reads as just 'group'. small patch: add `aria-labelledby="summary-title" aria-modal="true"` and move title into an h2 with id.
Jin Park: simple fix. I'll include in the modal refactor PR.
Maya Chen: 4) Live regions — when a long job completes we show a toast but SRs don't announce it reliably. use `role="status" aria-live="polite"` rather than `aria-hidden` toggles.
Alex Ruiz: noted. also the skip-nav link is present but hidden with `display:none` on focus it should become visible; current CSS uses `clip-path`, which some screen readers ignore. use the more compatible off-screen technique: `position:absolute; left:-9999px;` then move into view on `:focus`.
Samir Patel: thanks, great catch.
a11y-bot: automated scan results: axe-core found 4 violations (color-contrast x2, aria-allowed-attr x1, focus-order x1). screenshot: https://img.redwood/a11y-scan-1778402345.png
Maya Chen: proposed priorities: P0 focus order + modal ARIA + toast live region; P1 contrast adjustments; P2 reveal-on-focus tweaks.
Jin Park: i'll pick up P0 and P1 in the same PR if that's ok. estimate ~3 dev days.
Alex Ruiz: i'll do a quick design PR for the contrast swatches and update the console token table.
Samir Patel: can we add a tiny keyboard test to the e2e suite? puppeteer/headless keyboard tabbing capturing focus sequence for the dashboard route.
Maya Chen: yes pls. recommend checking focusable count and aria-label presence. add flaky tolerance.
Samir Patel: filed INF-6123 (a11y: dashboard keyboard + modal fixes). assign Jin + Alex.
Maya Chen: thanks team — i'll follow up with a tiny screen reader recording and short notes (VoiceOver + NVDA) in the JIRA. :white_check_mark:
Alex Ruiz: thumbs up. when fixed we should run another axe pass and re-run the `a11y-bot` scan before merging.
Jin Park: on it, starting branch `fix/a11y-dashboard-177840` now.
Maya Chen: saved the recording here: https://drive.redwood/voiceover-dashboard-177840.mp3 (short).
